A slip: a printed strip showing both game-text bars of the location, with its title and icons, around an empty middle where the art shows through, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-hothechomedlab-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]] (November 1996): The game text changes: “one of your” becomes “when you deploy a”; “droids” becomes “droid, it”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a white italic “E” (no title in the strip).

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
